entities.summary: The Teatro Rojas is a theater in the city of Toledo, Castile-La Mancha, Spain, inaugurated in 1879 on the site of the old corral de comedias, Mesón de la Fruta. Its construction involved several architects, and it is named after the local playwright Francisco de Rojas.
